Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 83. Category: form. God Forms.

Godly Transformation
The user’s crevices in their body disappear and they
grow larger and broader as well as becoming a vibrant
orange.
Increase your Power by 4
You deal an additional 2d6 to all damage
Increase your Movement Speed by 40 ft.
You gain 1 Rank of Bulk.
At the end of your turn, you lose 4 Stamina
